messages:
riley: Kicking off a targeted least-priv prune for KMS grants. I ran an entitlement delta and found 128 principals with decrypt grants in prod. Proposal: small canary (5 grants) across 2 non-critical services in us-west1, owner pings first, 72h monitor post-revoke.

nina: agree on canary. recommend owners get a 72-hour TTL. can we exclude any services with payment/token labels?

omar: +1. I checked last-use: ~52% show no decrypt events in 100+ days. I can produce a CSV with service tags, last-use, and HR owner email.

infrastructure-bot: Access snapshot generated: https://audit.internal/snap/3667894321 (45MB). Summary: 128 grants, 39 principals missing owner mapping, 67 >100d last-used.

riley: plan: 1) nina to send owner pings (72h) 2) after TTL, create revoke PR limited to 5 grants 3) PR triggers gated rollout job (max concurrency 2) 4) telemetry guard watches decrypt_fail_rate and job errors for 48h. rollback automatically if decrypt_fail_rate >0.5% for 10m or >10 total failures.

nina: drafting owner ping now. template: "You have N KMS decrypt grants. Please confirm necessity or request renewal by <date>. No response -> grant revoke planned for canary." will post in #eng-security.

omar: revoke workflow: use infra job that annotates change with audit-id and ticket. rollback steps: re-add binding, restart consumer, clear decrypt cache. I'll script the re-grant path and test in staging.

qa-oncall: add me as watcher. if we get decrypt errors from customers escalate immediately. also suggest a quick smoke of downstream consumers after each revoke (5m & 30m).

riley: good call. Nina will attach a short post-action checklist to the PR capturing owner evidence, time-to-rollback, and telemetry snapshots. Also require two approvers: service owner + security.

infrastructure-bot: Note: 39 principals flagged without owner mapping. Recommend manual owner discovery before revoking.

nina: I'll try HR reconciles for missing owners; if unknown, tag as "unknown-owner" and escalate to product managers for manual confirmation.

omar: telemetry thresholds: monitor three metrics - decrypt_errors_absolute, decrypt_error_rate_pct, downstream_job_failures. Auto-rollback criteria: decrypt_error_rate_pct increases >0.5 percentage points sustained for 10m OR downstream_job_failures >10 in 15m.

riley: timeline: owner pings today, wait 72h, PR Fri, observe Fri+Sat. I'll notify #support and oncall before merge. small steps, minimal blast radius.

nina: sending pings now. will post template and CSV link.

infrastructure-bot: Reminder scheduled: owner pings dispatched 2026-04-05T16:00Z.
